name: Amirtha Kasalipillai
title: High-Performing and Highly Reliable QA Engineer – GAD Squad, 2026
txt:
In 2026, Amirtha consistently demonstrated strong ownership, reliability, and technical capability as a QA Engineer in the GAD project. She successfully supported and delivered GAD Release 4 to Release 10 (EDL and PBI), including GAD PBI Performance Testing, without any delay, ensuring that all QA commitments and timelines were met. Her contributions were formally appreciated by Project Manager Joye in the Scrum calls for the successful delivery of EDL and PBI testing across all releases.

Amirtha played an active and dependable role in planning QA timelines, preparing test plans, test cases, and test scripts, and executing tests for both EDL and PBI. She handled defect retesting, regression testing, and PIV validations with diligence and attention to detail, helping to maintain the quality and stability of the GAD releases. She also took responsibility for QA metrics collection for the GAD project and consistently shared the metrics with the POC on time, improving visibility into testing progress and quality.

In addition, Amirtha successfully onboarded the Xray Test Case Management tool into the GAD project, which enhanced test case organization, traceability, and overall test management. Her work supported more structured and efficient QA processes within the squad. Although she is quiet and reserved by nature, Amirtha has demonstrated strong focus, discipline, and the ability to deliver high-quality outcomes on time. She is well recognized and valued by the GAD project squad and Project Manager Joye for her steady performance, reliability, and commitment to project success.

name: Amirtha Kasalipillai
title: Consistently Reliable and High-Impact QA Engineer – GAD Squad, 2026
txt:
In 2026, Amirtha consistently demonstrated strong ownership, reliability, and technical capability as a QA Engineer in the GAD project. She successfully contributed to GAD Release 4 through Release 10 across both EDL and Power BI (PBI) components, and supported GAD PBI Performance Testing, ensuring that all assigned QA activities were delivered on time and aligned with project expectations. There were no delays in her deliverables, and she maintained a high level of discipline in meeting planned timelines and quality standards.

Amirtha’s work on GAD included active participation in planning the QA timelines for multiple releases, where she collaborated with the Project Manager, Business Analysts (BAs), and Data Engineers (DEs) to align testing activities with overall release plans. She worked closely with the QA team to complete the performance testing for GAD PBI, contributing to both the preparation and execution phases. Her involvement covered end-to-end QA activities, including test plan creation, detailed test case design, and test script preparation, demonstrating her ability to handle both planning and hands-on execution responsibilities.

During test execution for EDL and PBI, Amirtha performed functional testing, defect retesting, regression testing, and PIV (Post Implementation Validation) with diligence and attention to detail. She ensured that defects were properly validated after fixes, regression coverage was maintained, and PIV activities were completed to support production stability. This thorough approach helped the squad maintain confidence in the quality of each release and reduced the risk of post-release issues.

Beyond core testing activities, Amirtha also contributed to QA Metrics collection for the GAD project and consistently shared these metrics with the POC on time. This supported better visibility into test progress, defect trends, and overall quality status, enabling the project team to make informed decisions and track QA performance across releases. Her ability to manage metrics in addition to test execution reflects strong organizational skills and reliability.

One of Amirtha’s notable contributions in 2026 was successfully onboarding the Xray Test Case Management tool into the GAD project. She helped integrate Xray into the team’s QA process, enabling more structured test case management, better traceability, and improved organization of test assets. This adoption of Xray enhanced the team’s ability to manage test scenarios and maintain alignment between requirements, test cases, and execution results. It also laid the foundation for more scalable and efficient QA practices within the squad.

Amirtha’s work and attitude were well recognized by the GAD project squad and Project Manager Joye. The team appreciated her consistent delivery of EDL and PBI testing across all releases and her contribution to performance testing activities. Although she is quiet and reserved by nature, she has demonstrated strong focus, commitment, and the ability to deliver high-quality outcomes independently and as part of the team. Her steady performance, reliability, and willingness to support key QA activities have made her a valuable member of the GAD squad in 2026 and a trusted resource for project delivery.

name: Aparna K R
title: Exceptional QE Leader and Domain Expert – RISK GCI, 2026
txt:
In 2026, Aparna K R was one of the top-performing QE resources in the RISK GCI area, consistently delivering all releases with thorough, end-to-end testing and zero defect leakage to production. Her combination of deep application knowledge and strong quality engineering skills made her a critical asset to the team and to the broader organization. Aparna understands the RISK GCI application in detail, both functionally and technically, and is widely recognized for her ability to recall and interpret requirements with exceptional accuracy. She was informally awarded the title ‘Walking & Talking Requirements Document’ because she had almost every single requirement at her fingertips and could quickly clarify scope, dependencies, and business rules for both QE and non-QE team members.

Beyond her own delivery responsibilities, Aparna consistently acted as a guide and mentor to junior team members and vendor resources, treating everyone as part of a single, cohesive team. She supported others in understanding requirements, designing test scenarios, and improving the overall quality of their work. Her collaborative, inclusive approach helped raise the standard of testing within the squad and ensured that new and external resources could ramp up quickly. She demonstrated strong leadership qualities even before her formal promotion, proactively sharing knowledge and driving best practices across the team.

Aparna also contributed to innovation initiatives such as the QE agentic solution and the self-healing UI automation framework. She provided domain input, practical feedback, and real-world testing perspectives that helped shape and accelerate these solutions. In addition, she invested in upskilling herself in Python, strengthening her technical capabilities and positioning herself to contribute to more advanced automation and tooling. Her willingness to learn and adopt new skills while maintaining high-quality delivery made her a strong role model within the team.

Recently, Aparna was promoted to Manager and moved into a Business Analyst role, where she is now redefining and expanding her skill set. She is actively helping Project Managers, Product Owners, and other BAs by bringing a unique blend of deep domain knowledge, QE experience, and analytical thinking. Her ability to handle multiple roles – QE, domain expert, mentor, and now BA – is rare and extremely valuable. Aparna’s personal goal has consistently been to deliver with zero issues, and she is known for extending her working hours when needed, without complaints, to ensure that last-minute changes and critical scenarios are properly tested and covered.

While her transition means the QE team loses a highly reliable and deeply knowledgeable tester, it is a positive development for her career and for the organization. I am proud to see her grow, add new skill sets to her profile as a BA, and continue to deliver value in whichever role she takes on. Given her track record, dedication, and ability to adapt, I am confident that Aparna will continue to excel and shine in any position, and she remains an outstanding example of end-to-end ownership, quality focus, and professional growth.
